categories.name_en: Protection from evil eye, magic & jinn
categories.description: Texts read to remove or block the evil eye (nazar), magic (sihr) and harm from jinn.
General refuge and safety texts for everyday protection of self, home and family.
Texts read for cure and relief from physical illness, pain and weakness.
Asking Allah to pardon sins, wipe away mistakes and accept repentance.

categories.name_en: Safety from Hellfire & entry to Paradise
categories.description: Asking to be saved from punishment in the Hereafter and granted Paradise.
Asking to be kept firm on the right path and to live and die as a believer.
Asking for patience, firmness and success when facing difficulty or enemies.

categories.name_en: Relief from distress & trust in Allah
categories.description: Read when anxious, afraid or overwhelmed; placing one’s affairs in Allah’s hands.
For spouse, children, parents and a righteous household.
For food, wealth, halal earnings, useful knowledge and blessed work.
Asking Allah to accept one’s worship, good deeds and duas.
Thanking and glorifying Allah; His names of majesty, power and perfection.
Protection from wrongdoers, fair judgement, and relief for the oppressed.
Asking Allah for respect, high standing and success in one’s efforts.
